rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for saying that something seems or appears to be a certain way.

example.english: I seem to think they aren't feeling well.
example.jyutping: ngo5 gok3 dak1 keoi5 hou2 ci5 m4 syu1 fuk6

rows.note: Use this when the impression comes specifically from how something looks.

example.jyutping: nei5 tai2 lok6 hou2 gui6 wo3

rows.note: Use this when making an inference that something seems to be the case, especially before a noun or adjective phrase.

example.english: They seem to be your classmate.
example.jyutping: keoi5 ci5 hai6 nei5 go3 tung4 hok6

rows.note: Use this when the impression comes specifically from how something sounds or from what you hear.

example.jyutping: teng1 lok6 nei5 gam1 jat6 hou2 gui6
